task_description: Build a modern, production-ready SaaS agency landing page using React + Vite + Tailwind CSS with dark glassmorphism theme, scroll animations via Framer Motion, 3D tilt effects, responsive design, and all specified sections (Header, Hero, Services, Process, Portfolio, Testimonials, Pricing, Contact, Footer).

verification.summary: npm run build (tsc -b && vite build) passes cleanly. Produces dist/ with index.html (0.92KB), CSS (23.11KB gzip 4.82KB), and JS (365.70KB gzip 114.12KB). All 9 components fully implemented with glassmorphism styling, Framer Motion animations, responsive design, 3D tilt effects, form validation, and prefers-reduced-motion support. Semantic review passed with APPROVED verdict. Post-review fixes applied for code quality (inline styles moved to Tailwind config, social links fixed).
